name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
full_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefit: ₹2 lakh life insurance cover at just ₹436/year premium
benefit_hindi: Sirf ₹436 saalana mein ₹2 lakh ka jeevan bima

eligibility.description: Any Indian citizen aged 18-50 years with a bank account
eligibility.description_hindi: 18-50 saal ka koi bhi Bharatiya naagrik jiske paas bank account ho
criteria: Must give consent for auto-debit of premium

steps_hindi: Apne bank ki branch mein jaayein
Premium bank account se kat jaayega
Har saal coverage renew hota hai

hindi_summary: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima mein sirf 436 rupaye saalana mein 2 lakh rupaye ka jeevan bima milta hai. Bank jaayein aur form bharein. 18 se 50 saal ke koi bhi vyakti le sakta hai.
